theme: Moving money through the legal maze
title: Treaty-Shopping Router: Routes, Not Rates
strategies: cheapest-per-hop shortest path (DAG shortest path / Dijkstra on withholding rates), never checking that substance and timing compliance are properties of the WHOLE route -- the trap

path enumeration with path-level feasibility filtering: search the small set of candidate routes through the layered treaty network, evaluate each route's aggregate substance-vs-benefit test (with instrument-mismatch halving) and its total holding-period window as a whole, and rank only the compliant routes by net-of-tax value
